summary.prose: Building this Story teaches the existing claude command-line provider to run against Ollama: an optional Ollama target makes every claude process it starts carry three environment variables pointing at the local Ollama server, in a copy of the environment for that process only. A small checker confirms before each run that Ollama answers, that the model is there and, for a cloud model, that Ollama is signed in, and fails with a named cause otherwise. The one place that builds providers for a family then sets the target for ollama-claude and refuses a tier whose model was not declared. A live test confirms a real structured answer from an Ollama cloud model.

tasks.title: Ollama target option and per-run environment on CliProvider
tasks.summary: In src/agent/providers/cli-provider.ts: add OllamaTarget { host, hosting } and the optional ollama field on CliProviderOpts; the constructor rejects it for a kind other than 'claude' or without a model. With a target, build the child environment per run as a copy: runClaude passes { ...process.env, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: host, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: 'ollama', ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: '' } without CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN to runSubprocess, and completeBoundedStructured merges the same into its boundedClaudeEnv() copy. Without a target nothing changes: runSubprocess gets no env and the bounded path keeps boundedClaudeEnv().

A provider without a target (claude, codex) starts with today's arguments and environment.
process.env is unchanged after an Ollama-targeted run.
new CliProvider with an Ollama target and kind 'codex', or without a model, throws.

tasks.title: checkOllamaTarget pre-run check
tasks.summary: New src/agent/providers/ollama-target.ts exporting OllamaTargetError (cause, host, model) and checkOllamaTarget(target, model, deps?). With plain fetch to target.host and a per-request limit (OLLAMA_LIST_TIMEOUT_MS, now exported from src/agent/providers/ollama.ts): GET /api/tags must answer (else 'ollama-unreachable'); the model must be among the tag names or POST /api/show must not answer 404 (else 'model-unavailable'); for hosting 'cloud', POST /api/me must answer 200 with a name (401 -> 'not-signed-in' with the signin_url; any other answer -> 'account-unavailable', per resolved question q93fd2759). Messages name the cause and the fix.
acceptanceChecks: Against a fake Ollama server: a down or silent server gives 'ollama-unreachable' within the limit; a missing model gives 'model-unavailable'; a cloud model with /api/me 401 gives 'not-signed-in' naming `ollama signin`; /api/me 503 gives 'account-unavailable'.
A local-hosting model skips /api/me; a model listed in /api/tags passes without /api/show.
Every request goes to target.host (a non-default address in the test).
OLLAMA_LIST_TIMEOUT_MS is exported with its value and listLocalModels' use unchanged.

tasks.title: CliProvider runs the check before every Ollama-targeted call
tasks.summary: An Ollama-targeted CliProvider awaits the pre-run check before each claude spawn (complete, completeStructured including the bounded path, runEditSession, runReviewSession); a failure throws OllamaTargetError, is logged at warn with model, host and cause, and starts no process. The check is reached through an injectable CliProviderOpts seam defaulting to checkOllamaTarget, and t1's tests pass a stub. Vendor providers never call the check. The existing time limit and process-group kill are untouched.
acceptanceChecks: A failing check on each entry point throws OllamaTargetError, logs model, host and cause at warn, and the fake claude records no run.
A passing check is followed by exactly one claude run per call; two awaited calls never overlap.
A provider without a target never calls the check.
